messages:
Sanjay: heads-up — I noticed the auto-fallback quarantine trigger fires but there’s no operator ack path in the console. we just drop into soft-degrade and ops only see it in logs
Mia: yeah that’s been confusing for oncall. sometimes tenants ask why a feature is in a degraded state with no visible cause
Oliver: agreed. proposal: add an "operator ack" action in the rollout detail panel that records who accepted the fallback and why, with a TTL and optional message
Jess: +1. needs audit trail too — immutable entry in the event stream with user, role, and reason
Sanjay: also want an optional auto-escalation if ack isn't provided within X minutes (configurable per-policy)
Mia: UI idea: when quarantine trigger fires show a non-blocking banner on the route that links to the rollout page, and a small CTA "Acknowledge fallback"
Oliver: edge case: what about product routes where product teams shouldn't be able to ack? need RBAC check (only operators + SRE team)
Jess: yep RBAC. events should include: trigger_id, signal_type, threshold_meta, route, model_version, and suggested next steps. And a snippet for the audit: 

```
{
  "trigger_id": "t-84b9",
  "action": "quarantine",
  "ack": {
    "by": "sanjay",
    "reason": "spike in 500s",
    "ttl_seconds": 1800
  }
}
```

Mia: love the snippet. UX nit: default ttl should be conservative (30m), but make it easy to extend from the ack modal
Sanjay: question for telemetry — do we store ack events in the same timeline as rollouts or in a separate audit index? separate index makes queries cheaper for security teams
Oliver: separate audit index + link back to rollout id. also add a compact telemetry view in console: recent acks, auto-retries, and unresolved quarantines
ops-console: (system) created new "quarantine_ack" audit type in staging. schema includes user_id, role, ttl, reason, rollout_id, and raw_trigger_payload
Jess: one more: if operator ack includes a TODO like "reroute to standby model", we should auto-create a checklist item on the rollout with a checkbox that ties to runbooks
Mia: +1 — ties into SDRs and postmortem flow. Also add an annotation field that surfaces in the trace playback
Sanjay: implementation ask: keep the ack API simple — POST /rollouts/:id/ack { by, reason, ttl_seconds } returns ack_id. backend appends to audit index and emits event on bus
Oliver: small sample request we can show in docs: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/rt-123/ack -d '{"by":"mike","reason":"mitigated 3rd party spike","ttl_seconds":3600}'

deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging: rollout-ack-endpoint v1.2.1 -> staging. smoke tests: ack creation + audit index write
Sanjay: thanks — can we also add a quick telemetry alert rule template: "unacknowledged_quarantine > 10min => pager to oncall" so teams can opt-in
Mia: that would have saved us last week. thanks everyone, nice concise plan
Oliver: i'll mock the modal tonight and push to figma, ping when ready for review
Jess: I’ll add the audit schema and example queries to the ops playbook repo
ops-console: (bot) staging deploy success: rollout-ack-endpoint v1.2.1. tests passed: ack write, audit index write, RBAC check
Sanjay: awesome — moving to implementation tickets
